name: mcp-boundary
description: Complete MCP engineering work on the active protocol, transport, capability, artifact, runtime, and host path.

interface.shortDescription: Complete MCP work on the live path
interface.longDescription: A pure-skill engineering plugin that traces active callers and entrypoints, implements or migrates the real MCP path, reconciles source with package and activated runtime, and keeps host claims inside qualifying observations.
capabilities: Trace active protocol and transport paths
defaultPrompt: Use $mcp-boundary to trace and repair the active MCP path, then verify the requested behavior.
Use $mcp-boundary to migrate this MCP implementation and retire superseded active paths.
Use $mcp-boundary to reconcile source, package, runtime, and named-host behavior without overstating evidence.
